title: Lookups route by verdict: the kb answers what it has, live docs what it lacks
goal: A lookup the kb does not cover goes straight to a lean live-docs researcher, a partial one sends only what the kb lacks to that researcher, and a clean good pack keeps today's route; each route carries a has/lacks differential, and false none and false good verdicts are guarded and detected.
notes: Its goal is delivered; BG-f7wpxbru is the last open child. Run backlog.py done on this epic once that bug is done, so the next sprint close deletes it.
